name: Grafana CLI (gcx)
description: Installs the Grafana CLI (gcx) from official GitHub releases.

hash.description: SHA-256/SHA-512 checksum for the downloaded artifact. Use 'auto' to look it up in the built-in version map, or 'disabled' to skip verification.

keychain.description: Allow gcx to use the OS keychain. When false, GCX_KEYCHAIN=off is exported (keychains are usually unavailable in containers).

telemetry.description: Allow gcx to send telemetry. When false, GCX_TELEMETRY=disabled is exported.
